title: Acute Presentation and Management of Abdominal Tuberculosis: A Ten-year Experience at a Tertiary Care Center in Pakistan
brief_summary: A prospective interventional study was conducted in Services Instituton of Medical Sciences all patients who underwent emergency laparotomy from 2008-2018 due to abdominal tuberculosis. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 21
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Both sexes and age between years and 90 years
* Patients presenting with acute abdomen and who underwent exploratory laparotomy
* Patients who diagnosis confirmed on biopsy (caseating granulomas)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Peritoneal tuberculosis
* Other causes of acute abdomen (Typhoid perforation)
* Patients diagnosed with abdominal tuberculosis and on conservative management
